entities.summary: Nikolay Nikolaevich Drozdov is a Russian doctor of biological sciences, candidate of geographical sciences, zoological sciences, professor of Moscow State University, a public figure, member of the expert council of the national award "Crystal Compass", a member of the media council of the Russian Geographical Society.
